label: preparing
what: A coordinated evening town-hall meeting and presentation, with substantial bread catering. Freight is arranging grain financing, baker will bake bread, builder supplies collateral, and innkeeper is involved in organizing. The event's underlying purpose remains undisclosed: a fortieth-service-anniversary surprise is plausible, not established.
